name: Feelings while watching a film
description: Watch a short first-person film (about 13½ minutes) of people climbing a skyscraper (no one is hurt), and continuously report how you feel by moving your mouse. Includes a short practice, some questions, and a short written description (at least 100 words). The film has no sound. Requires a desktop/laptop computer with a physical mouse or trackpad (not a touchscreen, pen/drawing tablet, or remote-desktop/virtual-machine session), and watching carefully in a quiet room, in full-screen mode, without distractions. Content note: heights footage; please do not take part if you have a strong fear of heights.
